instructions.input_binding: Use scripts/auth-stress-config.ts to resolve the password from XANO_ALPHA_TEST_PASSWORD. Send email and password as plain strings in a JSON request body. Reuse the resolved payload in every virtual-user loop; never generate random or base64 mock credentials.
instructions.target_binding: XANO_AGN_LOGIN_URL must be the full published AGN authentication endpoint, not https://xano.io. Do not run against the marketing homepage or guess a workspace path.
instructions.expected_response: Require HTTP 200 and a nonempty string in authToken, token, or auth_token. Never log passwords or returned tokens.
